create_curriculum_fixed: create a FixedCurriculum that always returns a fixed sequence length
create_curriculum_uniform: create a UniformCurriculum that samples sequence lengths uniformly from a set of values
create_curriculum_reverse_exponential: create a ReverseExponentialCurriculum that samples lengths from a reverse exponential distribution
create_curriculum_regular_increase: create a RegularIncreaseCurriculum that increases sequence length at regular intervals
test_curriculum_sample: test the sample_sequence_length method of a curriculum class with a given step
